LAREDO — A 64-year-old man was booked into the Webb County Jail on Thursday on three state jail felony charges, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Mario Carlos Ramos was arrested on October 23, 2026, at 2:54 p.m. The booking record charges him with burglary of vehicles with two or more prior convictions — a state jail felony under Texas law — with bond set at $15,000; theft of property valued under $2,500 with two or more prior convictions — also a state jail felony — with bond set at $15,000; and possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 1 or 1-B, in an amount under one gram — a state jail felony — for which bond had not been set as of booking.

The booking record does not list an arresting agency.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
